items.text: St. John's University Instant ADMISSIONS Decision Day will be hosted at South High on 11/9. Apply for free and receive a non-binding decision. You may be provided with scholarships on the spot as well. Criteria to participate is listed on the Google form on the Guidance Google Classroom. Complete the form by 10/9 if you are interested.
THERE WILL BE AN INTEREST MEETING FOR FASHION SHOW ON THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 5TH IN ROOM 207.

The PTO will be selling delicious apple cider donuts and pumpkin spice cookies for just $2 each on Friday, October 30th. Find them right across from the auditorium from before 1st period through the end of 2nd period.

Seniors applying to a college with a deadline of November 18, MUST submit their College Transcript Release Form to their guidance counselor by Friday, October 9th. Forms can be found in your guidance counselor’s Google Classroom.
